limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: non-overlapping historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded JEV-reviewed theme-level direction, magnitude, horizon, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Concrete procurement/industrial state changes: Patriot sale to Ukraine, EU-Canada defense alliance, US MI budget and research awards, Havelsan-Nigeria deal, North Korea drone expansion, CIEL-ASELSAN MoU, port arms-shipment strikes.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Authoritative macro releases: euro-area unemployment, Taiwan/US/German/Canada/French GDP and PMI data; local unemployment-administration stories deprioritized.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material supply shocks and verified market/price signals: Hormuz tanker attack, refinery strikes, Indian import pivot, Eni Libya gas deal, LNG forecasts, tanker shortfall, EU gas ban and forecast revisions.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified regulatory approvals and policy actions: FDA approvals (INOVIO, ketamine, Ultomiris, Ilumya), CMS Medicaid ruling, EU-Canada health cooperation, Medicare premium/premium cuts.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes with global transmission: Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, US/Iran escalation weighing, US Middle East drawdown, PLA drone milestone, EU Ukraine financing, sanctions and port strikes; penalized speculation-only pieces.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Central-bank decisions and verified inflation prints dominate; ECB, BOJ, Bank of Canada, BOE expectations, Fed expectations and producer/inflation data.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified shocks with cross-border relevance: Afghanistan quake, US shutdown deal, Israeli election deadlock, Greece/Turkey flood warnings, Arizona tornado emergency, Colorado wildfire power cuts, Easter Island quake, Spain train crash ahead of election.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Verified price moves and macro drivers: gold below $4,000 on oil/Hormuz, hawkish Fed pressure, Indian domestic crash, RBI reserves, Modi gold-buying call, rotation narrative, China offshore selling, capitulation commentary.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Verified corporate/regulatory state changes: Intel selloff, AI demand signals, Samsung 2nm orders, Nebius debt/data-center spending, Oracle-Nvidia expansion, global data-center buildout, Intel-AWS custom chip, EU CADA/Chips Act hearing.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Only a few distinct verified trade-policy changes existed; China-Switzerland tariff cut, China export controls on AI/biopharma, and Section 338 revisions are authoritative; many others are local/electoral or speculative.
